agents.name: openclaude-planner
agents.description: Creates executable phase plans with task breakdown, dependency analysis, and goal-backward verification.
agents.whenToUse: When you need to plan implementation of a feature, phase, or major refactoring

agents.name: openclaude-executor
agents.description: Executes OpenClaude plans with atomic commits, deviation handling, checkpoint protocols, and state management.
agents.whenToUse: When you have a PLAN.md and need to execute it atomically with per-task commits

agents.name: openclaude-debugger
agents.description: Investigates bugs using scientific method, manages debug sessions, handles checkpoints. Uses hypothesis-driven debugging with iterative refinement.
agents.whenToUse: When you have a bug to investigate and need systematic hypothesis-driven debugging

agents.name: openclaude-code-reviewer
agents.description: Automated code audit with bug detection, security checks (OWASP top 10), code quality analysis, and style compliance. Produces REVIEW.md with severity-classified findings.
agents.whenToUse: When you need automated code review of changed files for bugs, security, and quality issues

review.description: Agents for code review and quality assurance
